K01.name: a bare trace
K01.what: Only a title, a link, a test line or the event's name survives; the body is gone or there were no words. No act is in the words.
K01.verdict: material too thin; the bare-mention reading rule gives it its defined outcome (unplaced)

K02.name: a short reply whose object is lost
K02.what: A few words survive ('Addicted', 'The R?', 'Sweet', 'wat'), and what they answer or point at is not in the record.

K03.name: a picture remarked on, its owner or place unsaid
K03.what: The words react to, report or point at a canvas picture but do not say whether it is the room's own, a neighbour's beside the mark, or another room's elsewhere; the scheme's picture themes are cut by exactly that.
K03.verdict: mostly a fact the words omit; where the picture is plainly another room's away from the mark, the scheme is too narrow, since T3-052 takes only pictures beside the room's mark

K04.name: an April Fools joke whose maker is unsaid
K04.what: G01's themes are cut by who staged the joke (members, moderators, the maker), and the words do not say.

K05.name: another sub's April Fools change seen from this room
K05.what: Another sub's takeover or restyle reported, advertised, admired or credited here; under the visitor rule T3-023 is the room's own sub, and no G01 theme takes watching another's.

K06.name: April Fools play or talk that stages no fake
K06.what: Songs, fan art, roleplay, joke tools, imagined pranks, a birthday, prank stories and prompts: nothing posted as true, no change to the sub, not the maker's joke, no canvas (B4's 'gap ruled with the boundaries').

K07.name: the day marked or awaited, with no joke
K07.what: Waiting for the sub's event, remembering last year's, a holiday prompt, greetings for the day.

K08.name: a dispute over the room's own jokes
K08.what: Whether a joke needed /s, punched at autism, was childish, or should stay; T3-032 takes objection only at three concepts and no theme takes the defence.

K09.name: side talk and jokes with no canvas
K09.what: A running joke, a bot joke, a fandom argument or banter with no canvas in the words; T3-031 needs canvas talk, and since gate:28 the T3-017 | T3-031 question sends such talk to T3-017.
K09.verdict: not the scheme since gate:28; empty only where no reader and not my B1 placed T3-017, which J's re-read rule keeps out

K10.name: the sub's own moderation outside the canvas
K10.what: Removals and rules applied to posts that are not canvas posts, and the sub's ordinary choices; T3-063 takes canvas posts only (CC-004).

K11.name: talk about the canvas as a whole
K11.what: Why some pictures survive, whether Reddit used the event for its app, watching others' wars in timelapses; T3-016 explains the event and T3-037 weighs it, and neither takes these.
K11.verdict: scheme too narrow at the edge

K12.name: meaning or attachment given to the room's own mark
K12.what: Feeling territorial over the flag; a creed read into the Tree.
K12.verdict: material too varied: two items near T3-164, T3-157 and T3-156

K13.name: the room's work shown in other subs, with no joke and no call
K13.what: Pointing to another sub's discussion of the room's work; showing, asking about and promoting the grid elsewhere; T3-064 needs a joke and T3-062 a call for hands.
K13.verdict: scheme too narrow at the edge

K14.name: two tests met, and no field decides
K14.what: Each placement's must_show takes the material, neither must_not_show sends it away, or rule 0 meets a tie of more than three.
K14.verdict: bundled material; the scheme has no tiebreak sentence

K15.name: another deciding fact absent
K15.what: The boundary turns on a fact the words do not give: the time of a blame, whether a design is for the canvas, whether a pointer was given, who posted.

K16.name: a singular act no theme names
K16.what: Naming the Beam, asking what a standing sub does next, an unanswered slur, worry for the memorial's subject, a patch for sale, records of the sub's prank, retaliation off the canvas.
K16.verdict: material too varied: each in one room, below B1's floor of two rooms unlike each other

K17.name: material a theme fits, kept out by the lone-B1 floor alone
K17.what: Class 4: the agreeing readers' theme takes no concept, and my B1 theme's must_show takes the concepts.
K17.verdict: neither: the floor kept it out; placed under pass 4's revision

K18.name: lateness: arriving after the work, or told it is done
K18.what: Apologising for a day's delay, wishing one had known, telling a late helper the work is finished; T3-117's 'regret at the end' does not say whether these count.
K18.verdict: scheme too narrow at the edge
